clean_text: After the latest update my fingerprint login stopped working completely. Every time I open the app I have to re-enter my MPIN.
OTP is not coming at all. I have been trying to login for 30 minutes. Please fix this issue urgently.
App is good but sometimes the OTP takes too long. Biometric is also not working since last update.
Login failed 3 times today. OTP keeps saying expired even though I enter it immediately.
Cannot login since yesterday. Support not responding. Very disappointed.
My mutual fund portfolio has not refreshed in 3 days. The numbers shown are completely wrong.
Portfolio balance is showing old values. My recent SIP investment is not reflected anywhere.
Holdings keep showing stale data. I have to uninstall and reinstall to see updated values.
The stocks section shows prices from yesterday. Not useful for tracking real investments.
App is mostly good but the portfolio sync is slow. Takes 10-15 minutes to show latest NAV.
US stocks section is great but my order got stuck in processing for 2 hours. No error no confirmation.
Tried to buy Apple shares but the order failed silently. No notification nothing. Money was deducted.
Love the US stocks feature. Currency conversion could be more transparent though.
US stocks prices are not real-time. By the time I place the order the price has moved significantly.
Order for US stocks failed with a generic error. No explanation given. Very confusing.
Smart Save is the best feature. I saved 5000 rupees without even thinking about it this month.
The net worth dashboard is amazing. I can see all my investments in one place.
Customer support was very helpful. They resolved my issue within minutes via chat.
Best investment app in India. The mutual fund recommendations are spot on.
Very smooth experience overall. The goal-based savings feature is motivating.
